summary: Tested the new AI CV/biodata parsing feature end-to-end (backend + browser E2E) plus regression on existing dashboard flows. Backend: created /app/backend/tests/test_cv.py with 15 focused pytest cases (parse .txt CV, schema/field assertions, GET /cv ordering, PUT recompute of missing_fields + persistence, PDF download magic-bytes check, 401/403/404 authorization, 400 on unreadable file, admin list/stats/cross-user edit/download, non-admin 403). Full suite: 30/30 passed (test_cv.py 15 + existing backend_test.py 15). Frontend E2E: user login (+919812345670/123456) -> Documents tab (storage bar 0.0/100 MB) -> category 'CV / Resume' -> upload TEST_cv.pdf -> 'Parse to standard' -> toast 'CV parsed!' -> Standard CV tab renders CVEditor with correct parsed values (TEST Ramesh Nair / Second Officer / 15-08-2026 / 2 sea-service rows / 2 certificates) -> cleared nationality + Save -> missing-count badge '1 required field(s) missing' and the input turned RED -> restored + saved -> add/delete sea_service row works -> Download PDF opened /api/cv/{id}/pdf?auth=... returning 200 application/pdf 4291 bytes (%PDF-). Admin E2E: +910000000000 login shows nav-admin-btn, /admin shows 6 stat cards + 5 CV cards, opening a CV shows 'You are editing as ADMIN', edit + Save gives 'CV updated (admin)', admin-back-btn works. Route guard verified: anonymous and non-admin users visiting /admin are redirected to / and see no admin data. Regression: all dashboard tabs (matches/documents/cv/movement/history/support) render, feedback form present, no console errors.

minor.issue: uncertain_fields returned by the LLM use non-schema array keys, e.g. 'sea_service[0].from' / 'sea_service[0].to' instead of 'from_date' / 'to_date'. These paths never match any rendered input so the blinking-yellow highlight is silently lost (badge says '7 field(s) to verify' while only 1 input actually blinks). Normalize/validate LLM-returned paths against the schema server-side (or list exact keys in the prompt and drop unknown paths).

build_cv_pdf() omits the next_of_kin section although it is part of the standard schema and is parsed correctly (verified: {'name':'Latha Nair','relation':'Mother',...}). NOK data never appears in the downloadable standard CV.
extract_text_from_bytes only handles pdf/docx/txt/csv; legacy .doc is allowed by the UI file picker but always fails with the generic 400 'Could not read text from this file'.

ui_bugs.issue: No 'Next of Kin' section rendered — parsed next_of_kin (name/relation/contact) is invisible and non-editable in both user and admin modes even though it exists in the CV data.

Uncertain-field blink does not apply to sea_service/certificate date inputs because backend paths use 'from'/'to' while the columns are 'from_date'/'to_date' (counter badge and highlighted inputs disagree). Also the array-table inputs have no data-testid, so uncertain highlighting can't be asserted per field.
Save (PUT /cv/{id}) never sends uncertain_fields, so once the user verifies/corrects an auto-read field it keeps blinking yellow forever (no way to clear the 'to verify' state).
accept=".pdf,.png,.jpg,.jpeg,.doc,.docx" excludes .txt even though .txt CVs are a documented/supported parse input, and includes .doc which the backend cannot parse.

issues: Storage bar shows '0.0 MB / 100 MB' while 2 documents exist (rounding of small files) — consider KB precision
Parsed-CV list shows duplicate identical entries for repeated parses of the same document with no timestamp/date, making them indistinguishable (e.g. two 'cv.txt' rows)

action_items: Normalize LLM uncertain_fields paths to the actual schema keys (from_date/to_date etc.) and drop paths that don't resolve, so blinking highlight matches the 'N field(s) to verify' badge
Render an editable 'Next of Kin' section in CVEditor and include it in build_cv_pdf()
Send uncertain_fields (minus verified ones) on CVEditor save so blinking can be cleared
Add .txt to the file input accept list (and remove .doc or add legacy .doc extraction / clearer error)
Add data-testid to sea_service/certificates row inputs for testability
critical_code_review_comments: compute_missing/get_path only support dotted dict paths; array paths from the LLM are unvalidated — add a resolver that validates every uncertain path or they are silently dead.

merge_template() copies sea_service/certificates arrays verbatim from LLM output with no per-row key whitelist — malformed rows would render blank columns; consider coercing rows to the expected keys.
/api/cv/{id}/pdf accepts the JWT via ?auth= query param (also used by documents download) — token leaks into browser history/proxy logs; consider short-lived signed URLs.
server.py is ~970 lines; CV parsing + PDF builder + admin should be split into routers/modules.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of core CV flows (user upload->parse->edit->save->PDF, admin edit) passed; 4 minor UI gaps found

seed_data_creation: Test users +919812345670 (user) and +910000000000 (admin) plus TEST_cv.pdf / TEST_cv.txt documents and 5 parsed CV records left in DB (prefixed TEST where possible).
context_for_next_testing_agent: CV feature backend coverage lives in /app/backend/tests/test_cv.py (uses POST /api/documents for upload — NOT /documents/upload). Real Emergent LLM parse of a small .txt/.pdf CV completes in ~10-25s. Frontend testids verified working: doc-file-input (use set_input_files with a local /tmp pdf), doc-category-select + div[role=option], doc-parse-<id>, tab-cv, cv-select-<id>, cv-editor, cv-field-<section>.<key>, cv-save-btn, cv-download-btn (opens popup; assert via context request listener since chromium PDF viewer never fires domcontentloaded), missing-count, add-sea_service, del-sea_service-<i>, nav-admin-btn, admin-stat-<Label>, admin-cv-<id>, admin-back-btn. Known open gaps: uncertain path key mismatch (from/to vs from_date/to_date), next_of_kin not rendered/not in PDF, uncertain_fields never cleared on save.
rca_of_the_issue: Blinking-yellow highlight gap: parse_cv_with_ai asks the model for dotted paths of uncertain fields; the model returns 'sea_service[0].from'/'.to' while STANDARD_CV_TEMPLATE sea_service rows use from_date/to_date. CVEditor's ArrayTable builds paths as `${section}[${i}].${key}` with key=from_date, so uncertain.includes(path) is false and the field never blinks, while the header badge counts all uncertain entries — producing an inconsistent UI (7 to verify vs 1 blinking field). Fix by normalizing/validating paths server-side after parsing.
